name: Leaderboard
description: Track wins and ratings across any competition — video games, foosball, board games, and more. Elo-based ratings reward beating stronger opponents and winning with weaker teammates.

lb_matches.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.icon, c.game_type, c.created_at, c.created_by, COUNT(m.id) AS match_count, MAX(m.played_at) AS last_played FROM app_leaderboard__lb_categories c LEFT JOIN app_leaderboard__lb_matches m ON m.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.icon, c.game_type, c.created_at, c.created_by ORDER BY last_played DESC

insert.label: expand_participants
insert.statement: INSERT INTO app_leaderboard__lb_participants (id, match_id, member_id, team, result, rating_before, rating_after) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), :new.id, json_extract(j.value, '$.member_id'), CASE WHEN json_extract(j.value, '$.rank') = (SELECT MIN(json_extract(k.value, '$.rank')) FROM app_leaderboard__lb_matches AS n, json_each(CASE WHEN json_array_length(n.import_results_json) >= 2 THEN n.import_results_json WHEN n.import_winner_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_array(json_object('member_id', n.import_winner_id, 'rank', 1), json_object('member_id', n.import_loser_id, 'rank', 2)) ELSE '[]' END) AS k WHERE n.id = :new.id) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN json_extract(j.value, '$.rank') = (SELECT MIN(json_extract(k.value, '$.rank')) FROM app_leaderboard__lb_matches AS n, json_each(CASE WHEN json_array_length(n.import_results_json) >= 2 THEN n.import_results_json WHEN n.import_winner_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_array(json_object('member_id', n.import_winner_id, 'rank', 1), json_object('member_id', n.import_loser_id, 'rank', 2)) ELSE '[]' END) AS k WHERE n.id = :new.id) THEN 'win' ELSE 'loss' END, 0, 0 FROM app_leaderboard__lb_matches AS m, json_each(CASE WHEN json_array_length(m.import_results_json) >= 2 THEN m.import_results_json WHEN m.import_winner_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_array(json_object('member_id', m.import_winner_id, 'rank', 1), json_object('member_id', m.import_loser_id, 'rank', 2)) ELSE '[]' END) AS j WHERE m.id = :new.id

insert.label: fold_participant_ratings
insert.statement: INSERT INTO app_leaderboard__lb_participant_ratings (participant_id, match_id, member_id, rating_before, rating_after) SELECT p.id, p.match_id, p.member_id, COALESCE((SELECT r.rating FROM app_leaderboard__lb_ratings r WHERE r.member_id = p.member_id AND r.category_id = :new.category_id), 1000.0), MAX(100.0, COALESCE((SELECT r.rating FROM app_leaderboard__lb_ratings r WHERE r.member_id = p.member_id AND r.category_id = :new.category_id), 1000.0) + ROUND(32.0 * (CASE p.result WHEN 'win' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'draw' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END - 1.0 / (1.0 + pow(10.0, (COALESCE((SELECT AVG(COALESCE(r2.rating, 1000.0)) FROM app_leaderboard__lb_participants q LEFT JOIN app_leaderboard__lb_ratings r2 ON r2.member_id = q.member_id AND r2.category_id = :new.category_id WHERE q.match_id = :new.id AND q.team <> p.team AND (SELECT c.game_type FROM app_leaderboard__lb_categories c WHERE c.id = :new.category_id) <> 'cooperative'), 1000.0) - COALESCE((SELECT AVG(COALESCE(r2.rating, 1000.0)) FROM app_leaderboard__lb_participants q LEFT JOIN app_leaderboard__lb_ratings r2 ON r2.member_id = q.member_id AND r2.category_id = :new.category_id WHERE q.match_id = :new.id AND q.team = p.team AND ((SELECT c.game_type FROM app_leaderboard__lb_categories c WHERE c.id = :new.category_id) <> 'cooperative' OR q.member_id = p.member_id)), 1000.0)) / 400.0))))) FROM app_leaderboard__lb_participants p WHERE p.match_id = :new.id

insert.label: fold_ratings
insert.statement: INSERT INTO app_leaderboard__lb_ratings (id, member_id, category_id, rating, games_played, wins, losses) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), pr.member_id, :new.category_id, pr.rating_after, 1, CASE WHEN p.result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN p.result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM app_leaderboard__lb_participant_ratings pr JOIN app_leaderboard__lb_participants p ON p.id = pr.participant_id WHERE pr.match_id = :new.id ON CONFLICT (member_id, category_id) DO UPDATE SET rating = excluded.rating, games_played = games_played + 1, wins = wins + excluded.wins, losses = losses + excluded.losses

source.query: SELECT c.name AS title, printf('%d W - %d L', r.wins, r.losses) AS subtitle, r.member_id AS member_id FROM app_leaderboard__lb_ratings r JOIN app_leaderboard__lb_categories c ON c.id = r.category_id WHERE r.games_played > 0 ORDER BY r.rating DESC LIMIT 3

import_1v1_game.title: Import a finished 1v1 game
import_1v1_game.description: Record a two-player game another app finished as a match, creating its category the first time.

import_ranked_game.title: Import a finished ranked game
import_ranked_game.description: Record a game another app finished, with every player's finishing rank, as a match, creating its category the first time.

suggested_automations.title: Import Sea Battle games
suggested_automations.description: Every finished Sea Battle game is recorded as a match and folded into ratings.

suggested_automations.title: Import Quiet Time games
suggested_automations.description: Every finished Quiet Time session shared to the leaderboard is recorded as a match and folded into ratings.
